topic: Can the agent-based framework maintain optimal performance with increasing satellite users and unpredictable market demands?
consensus_response: The agent-based framework can maintain optimal performance under increasing satellite users and unpredictable market demands by integrating a robust fault-tolerant mechanism through a hybrid scheduling approach combining TDMA and CDMA elements. This enables efficient resource allocation, mitigating the effects of variable traffic patterns on spectral efficiency, latency, and resource utilization. The proposed solution also incorporates machine learning algorithms to predict and adapt to changing market conditions, ensuring optimal performance under varying demands.
reference_context: The reference context highlights the challenges faced by the agent-based framework in maintaining optimal performance due to inefficient spectrum allocation, high latency, and excessive resource utilization. It provides data on spectral efficiency, latency, and resource utilization for various scheduling algorithms, including Round Robin, Load Balancing, Perceptive Scheduling, TDMA, CDMA, and ALOHA.
